param: A Recruitment (birth/immigration) rate into the susceptible class.
β Effective transmission (contact) rate for primary infection (S infected by I), appearing in mass-action term β S I.
ε Correction factor for reinfection susceptibility of recovered individuals (scales reinfection term ε β R I). Typically 0–1.
γ Recovery rate from infectious to recovered (I → R).
δ Waning of natural immunity (R → S).
μ Natural death rate (applies to all compartments).
u Vaccination rate moving susceptible individuals to vaccinated (S → V).
θ Vaccine waning rate moving vaccinated individuals back to susceptible (V → S).
